scope: Published photographs for indoor whole-plant morphology comparison. Not a cultivation protocol or mechanical calibration.

references.title: Buckeye Relief: vegetative canopy
references.credit: Cannabis Business Times · Buckeye Relief · February 2023
references.classification: Commercial medical cannabis facility; not verified CBD hemp. Prior removal history unknown.
references.observation: Overlapping foliage forms a shared canopy. This is not a documented untreated control.

references.title: Buckeye Relief: plant structure at working height
references.credit: Cannabis Business Times · Buckeye Relief · February 2023
references.classification: Commercial medical cannabis; source identifies 92 Cookies. Not a same-plant before/after pair.
references.observation: Compare exposed lower stems, upper shoot arrangement, canopy depth and support hardware.

references.title: Buckeye Relief: leaf removal in progress
references.credit: Cannabis Business Times · Buckeye Relief · February 2023
references.classification: Commercial medical cannabis facility; photographed during defoliation.
references.observation: A close view of real access and occlusion around shoots; it cannot establish cutting forces or stiffness.

references.title: Lollipopping: publisher-labeled before / after
references.credit: Royal Queen Seeds · published comparison photograph
references.classification: Indoor tent example, not a factory. Not verified CBD hemp. Different framing between panels.
references.observation: The lower panel exposes long bare branches below the retained upper canopy. Before means before this pictured intervention, not never previously pruned.

references.title: Verified CBD hemp: indoor research plants
references.credit: Islam et al. (2022), Frontiers in Plant Science · Figure 9 · CC BY
references.classification: Alpine Star CBD hemp in indoor research chambers. Not a commercial factory or defoliation comparison.
references.observation: A chemotype-confirmed reference for whole-plant appearance. The panels show experimental groups, not a pruning sequence.
